<!-- Nues: pages open and reload at the top. On a fresh visit, or a reload / back visit to a page that was left at the top,
     the browser's scroll restoration and any scroll the page makes on its own while loading are ignored until the visitor scrolls.
     A reload or back visit from further down the page still returns to where the visitor was. Links with a #hash are left alone. -->
<script>
(function () {
  var KEY = 'nues-top:' + location.pathname, store = null;
  try { store = window.sessionStorage; } catch (e) {}
  var canSet = 'scrollRestoration' in history;
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', function () {
    var top = window.scrollY < 40;
    try { if (top) store.setItem(KEY, '1'); else store.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) {}
    if (canSet) history.scrollRestoration = top ? 'manual' : 'auto';
  });
  var nav = (performance.getEntriesByType && performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0]) || {};
  var type = nav.type || 'navigate', wasTop = false;
  try { wasTop = store.getItem(KEY) === '1'; } catch (e) {}
  if (location.hash || !(type === 'navigate' || wasTop)) return;
  if (canSet) history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
  var done = false, start = Date.now(), until = Infinity;
  function hold() {
    if (done) return;
    if (Date.now() > until || Date.now() - start > 8000) { done = true; return; }
    if (window.scrollY > 0) window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }
  function release() { done = true; }
  ['wheel', 'touchstart', 'keydown', 'mousedown'].forEach(function (t) { window.addEventListener(t, release, { passive: true, once: true }); });
  window.addEventListener('scroll', hold, { passive: true });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', hold);
  window.addEventListener('load', function () { until = Date.now() + 1000; hold(); setTimeout(hold, 300); setTimeout(hold, 900); });
})();
</script>

/* Nues: buttons and links, as in nues-buttons.html. Buttons use "Shift", arrow links use "Glide".

   svc-btn-outline, cs-hero_btn, button.is-big-alternate = ghost button, hover 90% white border and 6% white fill).
   Only the moving parts and parent hover -> child effects live here. */
/* Circle arrows: the circle fills when the whole link is hovered. Arrow links fill navy (white arrow), on dark (.is-white)
   white (navy arrow); cards stay mint. The arrow passing through the circle is in the site footer (arrow swap). */

/* Buttons ("Shift"): at rest a button is just its label; on hover the label slides 12px left and an arrow slides in from the
   right a moment later, moving the way it points (so the two never overlap), and a press shrinks it a little. The script in the site footer wraps the label (.btn-shift_text), adds the arrow
   (.btn-shift_icon, its right edge 12px inside the button's padding) and hides any arrow the button had. */
:root{--btn-move:cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1);--btn-soft:cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1);--btn-out:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}

@media (hover:hover){[data-shift]:hover .btn-shift_text{translate:-12px 0;transition:translate .5s var(--btn-out)}[data-shift]:hover .btn-shift_icon{opacity:1;translate:0 0;transition:translate .45s var(--btn-out) .16s,opacity .25s var(--btn-soft) .18s}}

    '<div class="pg_top"><span class="pg_logo"></span><button type="button" class="pg_close" aria-label="Close gallery"><i></i><i></i></button></div>' +
    '<p class="pg_count" aria-live="polite"></p>' +
    '<div class="pg_frame"><div class="pg_stage"></div>' +
    '<button type="button" class="pg_arrow is-prev" aria-label="Previous screen">' + CHEV + '</button>' +
    '<button type="button" class="pg_arrow is-next" aria-label="Next screen">' + CHEV.replace('M22 2L3 21.5 22 41', 'M2 2l19 19.5L2 41') + '</button></div>' +
    '<p class="pg_cap"></p><div class="pg_thumbs"></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(pg);
  var dim = pg.querySelector('.pg_dim'), logo = pg.querySelector('.pg_logo'), count = pg.querySelector('.pg_count'),
      stage = pg.querySelector('.pg_stage'), cap = pg.querySelector('.pg_cap'), dots = pg.querySelector('.pg_thumbs'),
      prev = pg.querySelector('.is-prev'), next = pg.querySelector('.is-next'), closeBtn = pg.querySelector('.pg_close');
  var card = null, slides = [], els = [], cur = 0, W = 0, H = 0, dragX = 0, opener = null;

  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  function size() {
    var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight, mob = vw < 768;
    var maxW = mob ? vw - 32 : Math.min(1056, vw * .7333, vw - (vw < 992 ? 160 : 300));
    var chrome = mob ? 290 : 470;
    H = Math.max(160, Math.min(maxW / RATIO, vh - chrome)); W = H * RATIO;
    pg.style.setProperty('--pg-w', W + 'px');
    pg.style.setProperty('--pg-h', H + 'px');
  }
  // neighbours sit to the sides, smaller and darker; dragging moves them all
  function place(anim) {
    var gap = W * .9;
    els.forEach(function (el, i) {
      var d = i - cur + dragX / gap, a = Math.min(Math.abs(d), 1.6), k = Math.min(a, 1);
      el.classList.toggle('is-anim', !!anim);
      el.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (d * gap) + 'px) scale(' + (1 - k * .16) + ')';
      el.style.filter = 'brightness(' + (1 - k * .68) + ')';
      // at rest only the middle screen shows (as in the design); the neighbours fade in while you drag or switch
      el.style.opacity = 1 - k;
      el.style.zIndex = 10 - Math.round(a * 3);
      el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(i !== cur));
    });
    [].forEach.call(dots.children, function (b, i) { b.classList.toggle('is-on', i === cur); b.setAttribute('aria-current', String(i === cur)); });
    var s = slides[cur], dom = card.getAttribute('data-gallery-domain') || '';
    count.innerHTML = pad(cur + 1) + ' / <span>' + pad(slides.length) + '</span>';
    cap.innerHTML = (s.page ? s.page + ' ' : '') + '<span>' + dom + '</span>';
    cap.style.visibility = s.page || dom ? '' : 'hidden';
    prev.disabled = cur === 0; next.disabled = cur === slides.length - 1;
  }
  function go(i) { cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, i)); dragX = 0; place(true); }
  // opening: the page rises out of a soft clip in the middle of the screen; closing: it sinks back and fades.
  // (No growing out of the card: the card screens and the slider pages have different shapes, so a morph stretches them.)
  function riseIn(el) {
    var base = el.style.transform, r = getComputedStyle(el).borderTopLeftRadius;
    return el.animate([
      { opacity: 0, transform: base + ' translateY(56px) scale(.94)', clipPath: 'inset(7% 7% 7% 7% round ' + r + ')' },
      { opacity: 1, transform: base, clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0% round ' + r + ')' }
    ], { duration: 950, delay: 60, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)', fill: 'backwards' });
  }
  function sinkOut(el) {
    var base = el.style.transform;
    return el.animate([
      { opacity: 1, transform: base },
      { opacity: 0, transform: base + ' translateY(28px) scale(.97)' }
    ], { duration: 380, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)', fill: 'forwards' });
  }

  function open(c, i, from) {
    card = c; slides = slidesOf(c); if (!slides.length) return;
    cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, i)); opener = from || c;
    var info = c.closest('.home-projects_item, .svc-case_row'), lg = info && info.querySelector('.home-projects_logo-wrapper img, .svc-case_logo img');
    logo.innerHTML = lg && shown(lg) ? '<img src="' + (lg.currentSrc || lg.getAttribute('src')) + '" alt="' + (lg.getAttribute('alt') || '') + '">' : '';
    var font = info && info.querySelector('.home-projects_stat > *, .svc-case_value');
    if (font) pg.style.setProperty('--pg-font', getComputedStyle(font).fontFamily);
    stage.innerHTML = ''; dots.innerHTML = ''; els = [];
    var name = c.getAttribute('data-gallery-name') || (lg && lg.getAttribute('alt')) || '';
    slides.forEach(function (s, j) {
      var el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'pg_slide';
      el.innerHTML = '<img src="' + s.src + '" alt="' + (name + ' ' + (s.page || 'page ' + (j + 1))).trim() + '" draggable="false">';
      stage.appendChild(el); els.push(el);
      var b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'pg_thumb'; b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show ' + (s.page || 'screen ' + (j + 1)));
      b.innerHTML = '<img src="' + s.thumb + '" alt="">';
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { go(j); });
      dots.appendChild(b);
    });
    dots.style.display = slides.length > 1 ? '' : 'none';
    pg.classList.add('is-open');
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    size(); place(false);
    var el = els[cur];
    if (!still && el.animate) {
      riseIn(el);
      els.forEach(function (o, j) { if (j !== cur) o.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: o.style.opacity }], { duration: 600, delay: 450, easing: 'ease', fill: 'backwards' }); });
    }
    setTimeout(function () { pg.classList.add('is-ready'); }, still ? 0 : 300);
    closeBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  function close() {
    if (!pg.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    var el = els[cur];
    pg.classList.remove('is-ready');
    function done() {
      pg.classList.remove('is-open'); dim.style.opacity = '';
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
      stage.innerHTML = ''; els = [];
      if (opener) opener.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    if (!still && el && el.animate) {
      els.forEach(function (o, j) { if (j !== cur) o.style.opacity = 0; });
      el.classList.remove('is-anim');
      dim.style.opacity = 0;
      sinkOut(el).onfinish = done;
    } else done();
  }

  // the cards: the card opens the first slide, a side screen opens its own page (left 2nd, right 3rd)
  cards.forEach(function (c) {
    var shot = c.querySelector('.home-projects_image-wrapper') || c;
    var z = document.createElement('span'); z.className = 'pg-zoom'; z.innerHTML = ZOOM; shot.appendChild(z);
    c.setAttribute('role', 'button'); c.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    c.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open ' + (c.getAttribute('data-gallery-name') || 'project') + ' gallery');
    var screens = frames(c), pages = slidesOf(c).length;
    screens.forEach(function (t, k) {
      if (t && k > 0 && k < pages) { t.setAttribute('role', 'button'); t.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); t.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open screen ' + (k + 1)); }
    });
    function which(e) {
      var t = e.target.closest('.home-projects_screen-frame'), k = t ? screens.indexOf(t) : -1;
      return k > 0 && k < pages ? { k: k, from: t } : { k: 0, from: c };
    }
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var w = which(e); open(c, w.k, w.from); });
    c.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var w = which(e); open(c, w.k, w.from);
    });
  });

  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', close);
  dim.addEventListener('click', close);
  prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(cur - 1); });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(cur + 1); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!pg.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(cur + 1);
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(cur - 1);
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
      // keep keyboard focus inside the popup
      var f = [].slice.call(pg.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled])')).filter(function (b) { return b.offsetParent; });
      var a = f[0], z = f[f.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === a) { z.focus(); e.preventDefault(); }
      else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === z) { a.focus(); e.preventDefault(); }
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (pg.classList.contains('is-open')) { size(); place(false); } });

  // drag or swipe between screens; a tap next to the screen closes the gallery
  var down = null, moved = false;
  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    down = { x: e.clientX, t: performance.now() }; moved = false;
    stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); stage.classList.add('is-drag');
  });
  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    if (!down) return;
    dragX = e.clientX - down.x; if (Math.abs(dragX) > 4) moved = true;
    if ((cur === 0 && dragX > 0) || (cur === slides.length - 1 && dragX < 0)) dragX *= .35;
    place(false);
  });
  function up(e) {
    if (!down) return;
    stage.classList.remove('is-drag');
    var v = dragX / Math.max(1, performance.now() - down.t), d = dragX; down = null;
    if (!moved) {
      var r = els[cur].getBoundingClientRect(); dragX = 0;
      if (e.clientX >= r.left && e.clientX <= r.right && e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom) place(true); else close();
      return;
    }
    if (d < -W * .18 || v < -.5) go(cur + 1); else if (d > W * .18 || v > .5) go(cur - 1); else go(cur);
  }
  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
});
